content.title: What time does Wrestlemania start today? Night 2 match card, results
content.text: April 19, 2026, 10:21 a.m. ETThe first night of WrestleMania 42 is in the book. Really, it's one to forget.The crowd seemed conflicted at best and confused at worst to end the show as Cody Rhodes retained the world title over Randy Orton to a chorus of boos. But then the show ended with Orton punting Rhodes in the head. Using the main event of WrestleMania to continue a feud is strange. As was the inclusion of sports talk host Pat McAfee and singer Jelly Roll. Who wanted those things?Don't forget about the advertisements, either. WWE has mastered the art of capitalism and it seemed like Saturday's show was more ads than entertainment.Maybe the second night will be better. Here's how to watch it:WrestleMania 42 night 2 start time: What time does WrestleMania start tonight?The second night of WrestleMania 42 begins at 6 p.m. ET. Coverage begins at 3 p.m. ET on WWE's various social media channels.How to watch WrestleMania 42 night 2The first hour of WrestleMania 42 – the first two matches – is airing on ESPN2 and ESPN's streaming service. There will be five matches on the pay portion of the card.How much does WrestleMania cost?In the U.S. you'll need an ESPN Unlimited subscription to watch WrestleMania. A standalone subscription for Unlimited is $29.99 a month. You can bundle Disney+, Hulu and ESPN Unlimited for $35.99 a month. You don't need to pay an extra fee for WrestleMania.Where is WrestleMania 42 happening?WrestleMania 42 is taking place in Las Vegas at Allegiant Stadium, home of the NFL's Las Vegas Raiders.WrestleMania 42 match card for tonightHere is the card for tonight, in no particular order.Oba Femi vs. Brock Lesnar (on ESPN)Intercontinental Championship ladder match: Penta (c) vs. Je'Von Evans vs. JD McDonagh vs. Dragon Lee vs. Rusev vs. Rey Mysterio (on ESPN)Demon Finn Bálor vs. Dominik MysterioUnited States Championship match: Sami Zayn (c) vs. Trick WilliamsWWE Women's Championship match: Jade Cargill (c) vs. Rhea RipleyWorld Heavyweight Championship match: CM Punk (c) vs. Roman ReignsWrestleMania 42 results from night 1The Usos (Jey Uso and Jimmy Uso) and LA Knight defeated The Vision (Logan Paul and Austin Theory) and IShowSpeed by pinfallJacob Fatu defeated Drew McIntyre by pinfallBrie Bella and Paige (with Nikki Bella) defeated The Irresistible Forces (Nia Jax and Lash Legend) (c), Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss, and Bayley and Lyra Valkyria by pinfallBecky Lynch defeated AJ Lee (c) by pinfallGunther defeated Seth Rollins by technical submissionLiv Morgan defeated Stephanie Vaquer (c) by pinfallCody Rhodes (c) defeated Randy Orton by pinfallIs WrestleMania on Peacock?No, you can no longer watch WrestleMania on NBC's streaming app Peacock.Is Danhausen on WrestleMania today?WWE's spooky new wrestler doesn't have a match on either night of WrestleMania 42. So expect him to show up in some fashion during a backstage segment. Maybe he'll even hit someone with a curse.Is John Cena at WrestleMania?After being retired in December, John Cena will be making his return to WWE as the host of WrestleMania.
